reviewer: quality_research (wrapper author; independent v2 review requested from adversarial_code)

tests.process_tables: Synthetic CPU snapshots with nested sessions; local temporary lease filesystem only

fixed_finding.original_behavior: A new descendant generation reusing an old PID was not registered, which could hide its survivor at lease release.
fixed_finding.v2_behavior: Replace an expired descendant identity only when current ancestry is proven through a live owned parent or original live leader process group; retain historical starts. A changed leader generation or malformed process metadata fails closed. An unrelated reused PID is never adopted. A new group member first observed after the leader exits fails closed unless its live owned-parent ancestry is proven.

compatible_lifecycle.serial_child_structure: Each phase has CPU command emitter, model child, CPU verifier:15 direct serial children. The train SFT process can synchronously wait for another start_new_session workflow child.
compatible_lifecycle.sessions: start_new_session changes session/process group, not parent ancestry; v2 traverses live parent chains and keeps observed reparented child identities.
compatible_lifecycle.successful_release: Requires top-level runner exit0, completed_pending_quality_audit receipt with no error, no observed live descendants, unchanged pinned inputs/request/wrapper/protocol and unchanged own lease.
compatible_lifecycle.failure: Runner errors stop later phases and its existing cleanup may signal only its own observed descendants/process group. Outer wrapper never signals and deliberately keeps its own lease after failed/interrupted/mismatched/uncertain completion, even if child cleanup already succeeded.
compatible_lifecycle.quality: completed_pending_quality_audit is operational completion. quality_certified remains false; lease release is not scientific validation.
compatible_lifecycle.environment: Outer wrapper inherits environment. Set MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0 before invocation and ensure no other MLX_* variables. Inner guard enforces exact MLX environment and each child records TF32=0.

concrete_request_requirements.execution_gate: Completed checkpoint full-byte copy verification, newly prepared immutable plan and independent concrete-plan review are still required. No concrete plan/checkpoint SHA is fabricated here.
concrete_request_requirements.cwd: Exact canonical plan cwd (frozen runtime root).
input_hashes_required: planned Python executable path and fully resolved target when symlinked
source full-payload manifest bound by that receipt
concrete_request_requirements.transitively_guarded: The hash-bound helper/plan/runtime snapshot retain their original runtime, dataset, adapter and model validation responsibilities. Do not add repeated entire-model reads to the lease wrapper.
never_pin_mutable_outputs: project.json (initial hash is checked by the inner plan before training; legitimate project state can change)
concrete_request_requirements.unique_fresh_paths: Outer request, wrapper receipt/log/state and inner launcher receipt/logs must be distinct. Completion output absent initially; original failed attempts preserved.
concrete_request_requirements.campaign_boundary: Hold shared lease only for this immediate serial model campaign. Complete transfer/CPU preparation/review first. No unrelated download, analysis, compilation or follow-up workloads inside it.

limitations: No actual long-campaign launch or stress test was performed.
ps lstart has limited timestamp resolution; observed ancestry supports cooperative reviewed processes, not malicious daemon/OS attestation.
A very short unobserved parent that intentionally daemonizes cannot be proven absent by polling; current reviewed runner/runtime synchronously wait for their children.
Source/input stat and hash checks require a quiescent trusted execution host, not protection against a hostile concurrent writer.
An interrupted outer wrapper does not forward a stop signal; its children may remain active behind the retained lease until explicit coordinator review.
Final model quality and fixed final checkpoint/step selection require separate result audits.
